blocks.zh: Section 12 Container Closure Integrity (CCI) 容器密封完整性
blocks.en: Section 12 Container Closure Integrity (CCI)

blocks.zh: 從法規基礎、設計介面、製程管控到 CCI 測試方法工具箱的完整解析
blocks.en: A complete walk-through from regulatory basis and design interfaces to process controls and the CCI test method toolbox

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 CCI 在無菌保證整體策略中的核心地位，掌握基於風險的全生命週期 CCI 控制方法
blocks.en: Understand the central role of CCI in the overall sterility assurance strategy, and master a risk-based, lifecycle approach to CCI control

blocks.zh: 掌握全球法規對無菌產品 CCI 的要求，以及整體性無菌保證方法的三層次架構
blocks.en: Understand global regulatory expectations for CCI of sterile products, and the three-layer structure of the holistic approach to sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 瞭解 PFS 三大密封介面（活塞/筒身、筒身/針頭保護套、針頭/針頭保護套）各自的 CCI 功能與設計考量
blocks.en: Understand the CCI function and design considerations of the three PFS sealing interfaces (plunger stopper/barrel, barrel/needle shield, needle/needle shield)

blocks.zh: 掌握供應商管理、來料管控與半成品注射器 CCI 評估的核心要素
blocks.en: Master the key elements of supplier management, incoming material control and CCI assessment of semifinished syringes

blocks.zh: 全面認識 CCI 測試方法工具箱，包括五大主要技術的偵測極限、優缺點、USP <1207> 確定性 vs 機率性分類，以及 PIC/S Annex 1 的完整性期望
blocks.en: Gain a full picture of the CCI test method toolbox, including the detection limits and pros and cons of the five main technologies, the USP <1207> deterministic vs probabilistic classification, and the integrity expectations of PIC/S Annex 1

blocks.zh: 學習如何根據產品特性（電導率、蛋白質含量）選擇、開發與驗證合適的 CCI 測試方法
blocks.en: Learn how to select, develop and validate a suitable CCI test method according to product characteristics (conductivity, protein content)

blocks.zh: 12.0 Container Closure Integrity Requirements 容器密封完整性需求
blocks.en: 12.0 Container Closure Integrity Requirements

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CCI 在無菌保證中的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Position of CCI in Sterility Assurance

blocks.zh: Container Closure Integrity（容器密封完整性，CCI）是無菌藥品整體無菌保證計畫的重要組成，不是孤立的測試項目，而是與以下多層次管控措施協同運作：
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI) is an important component of the overall sterility assurance program for sterile drug products. It is not an isolated test but works together with the following layers of control:

blocks.zh: 設計驗證 (Design Verification) 與堆疊公差 (Stacked Tolerance)
blocks.en: Design verification and stacked tolerance

blocks.zh: 確認驗證 (Qualification)
blocks.en: Qualification

blocks.zh: 製造製程管控 (Manufacturing Process Controls)
blocks.en: Manufacturing process controls

blocks.zh: 培養基灌充模擬 (Media Fill / Process Simulation)
blocks.en: Media fill / process simulation

blocks.zh: 微生物挑戰試驗與物理挑戰試驗
blocks.en: Microbial challenge testing and physical challenge testing

blocks.zh: CCI 的最終目標：證明 PFS 能維持其微生物屏障 (microbial barrier) 的完整性。
blocks.en: The ultimate goal of CCI: to demonstrate that the PFS maintains the integrity of its microbial barrier.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: CCI 就像建築物的防水系統——光靠最後的漏水測試是不夠的。你需要在設計階段選好防水材料（設計驗證）、施工時做好每層防水層（製程管控）、完工後進行整體漏水測試（CCI 測試）。PFS 的 CCI 也是同樣的道理：層層管控，最後用測試確認。
blocks.en: CCI is like the waterproofing system of a building: a leak test at the very end is not enough. You need to choose the right waterproofing materials at the design stage (design verification), build each waterproofing layer properly during construction (process controls), and run an overall leak test after completion (CCI testing). The same applies to PFS CCI: control it layer by layer, then confirm with testing at the end.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：風險基礎、階段適配
blocks.en: Key Point: Risk-Based, Phase-Appropriate

blocks.zh: Phase-appropriate approach（階段適配方法）是本節的關鍵原則。CCI 測試的要求隨產品開發階段而遞進：
blocks.en: The phase-appropriate approach is the key principle of this section. CCI testing requirements progress with the stage of product development:

blocks.zh: 設計/開發階段：評估 C/C 系統設計的 CCI 可行性
blocks.en: Design/development stage: assess the CCI feasibility of the C/C system design

blocks.zh: 確認驗證階段：建立並驗證 CCI 測試方法
blocks.en: Qualification stage: establish and validate the CCI test method

blocks.zh: 例行生產：持續監控 CCI 合規性
blocks.en: Routine production: continuously monitor CCI compliance

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究：評估貨架壽命期間 CCI 的維持
blocks.en: Stability studies: evaluate the maintenance of CCI over the shelf life

blocks.zh: 這與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 中對無菌屏障系統持續整合性的要求一致。
blocks.en: This is consistent with the requirement of PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) for the continued integrity of the sterile barrier system.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: CCI 與培養基灌充 (media fill) 在無菌保證計畫中各自扮演什麼角色？兩者能否互相替代？
blocks.en: What roles do CCI and media fill each play in the sterility assurance program? Can one replace the other?

blocks.zh: 「Phase-appropriate approach」在 CCI 測試中具體意味著什麼？請舉例說明開發階段與商業化階段的差異。
blocks.en: What does a "phase-appropriate approach" specifically mean for CCI testing? Give examples of the differences between the development stage and the commercial stage.

blocks.zh: 12.1 Regulatory Basis for Container Closure Integrity 容器密封完整性的法規依據
blocks.en: 12.1 Regulatory Basis for Container Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: C/C 系統適用性的四個面向
blocks.en: Four Aspects of C/C System Suitability

blocks.zh: PDA TR73 引用的四面向適用性框架（文獻 12）是監管提交和系統確認的核心架構：
blocks.en: The four-aspect suitability framework cited in PDA TR73 (reference 12) is the core structure for regulatory submissions and system qualification:

blocks.zh: Protection（保護性）：防止微生物污染和洩漏——CCI 的核心
blocks.en: Protection: prevents microbial contamination and leakage; this is the core of CCI

blocks.zh: Safety（安全性）：包裝材料不對患者或藥品造成傷害
blocks.en: Safety: the packaging materials do not cause harm to the patient or the drug product

blocks.zh: Compatibility（相容性）：包裝材料與藥品不發生不良交互作用（參見 Section 14 E&L）
blocks.en: Compatibility: the packaging materials do not interact adversely with the drug product (see Section 14, E&L)

blocks.zh: Performance（性能）：包裝系統在預期使用條件下正常運作
blocks.en: Performance: the packaging system functions properly under the intended conditions of use

blocks.zh: 整體性無菌保證的三層架構
blocks.en: The Three-Layer Structure of Holistic Sterility Assurance

blocks.zh: 無法對每個單元進行無菌試驗，因此業界採用三層整體性方法：
blocks.en: Because sterility testing of every unit is not possible, the industry uses a three-layer holistic approach:

blocks.zh: 層次一：製程驗證（末端滅菌或無菌製程符合 cGMP）
blocks.en: Layer 1: process validation (terminal sterilization or aseptic processing in compliance with cGMP)

blocks.zh: 層次二：CCI 保證（一次包裝能維持整個貨架期的微生物屏障）
blocks.en: Layer 2: CCI assurance (the primary package maintains the microbial barrier throughout the shelf life)

blocks.zh: 層次三：放行無菌試驗（符合藥典指引的驗證方法）
blocks.en: Layer 3: release sterility testing (a validated method that complies with pharmacopoeial guidance)

blocks.zh: 這三層架構與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) Section 8 的無菌保證原則一致，也呼應 EU Guideline 10, Annex 1 不得單獨依賴任何終端製程或成品測試的要求。
blocks.en: This three-layer structure is consistent with the sterility assurance principles of PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) Section 8, and also echoes the requirement of EU Guideline 10, Annex 1 not to rely solely on any terminal process or finished product test.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：法規連結
blocks.en: Key Point: Regulatory Link

blocks.zh: Taiwan CDMO 實務重點：TFDA 要求與 PIC/S GMP 接軌。PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 明確要求製藥廠建立對容器密封系統的整合性保證策略，不得僅依賴成品無菌試驗。因此，建立完整的 CCI 測試計畫（從設計確認到商業化例行監控）是法規符合的必要條件，也是 TFDA 查廠的重點項目之一。
blocks.en: Practical focus for a Taiwan CDMO: TFDA requirements are aligned with PIC/S GMP. PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) explicitly requires manufacturers to establish an integrated assurance strategy for the container closure system and not to rely solely on finished product sterility testing. A complete CCI testing program (from design confirmation to routine commercial monitoring) is therefore a necessary condition for regulatory compliance, and is also one of the focus areas of TFDA inspections.

blocks.zh: Parametric Release（參數式放行）：在特定情況下，若已獲主管機關批准，可以用製程參數（如滅菌參數的合規）代替無菌試驗進行放行，但這需要嚴格的驗證基礎。
blocks.en: Parametric release: in specific cases, with approval from the competent authority, release can be based on process parameters (such as compliance with sterilization parameters) instead of sterility testing, but this requires a rigorous validation basis.

blocks.zh: 為什麼說「完全無菌試驗（對每個單元進行檢測）」在實際上不可行？這與統計學和法規有何關聯？
blocks.en: Why is "complete sterility testing (testing every unit)" not practically feasible? How is this related to statistics and regulations?

blocks.zh: EU Guideline 10, Annex 1 強調不得單獨依賴末端製程或成品測試——這對你在 CDMO 的 CCI 策略開發有什麼實質影響？
blocks.en: EU Guideline 10, Annex 1 stresses that a firm must not rely solely on terminal processes or finished product testing. What practical impact does this have on developing a CCI strategy at your CDMO?

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 對容器密封完整性有哪些具體期望？如何將這些期望轉化為可操作的控制策略？
blocks.en: What specific expectations does PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) have for container closure integrity? How can these expectations be translated into an actionable control strategy?

blocks.zh: 12.2 PFS Design Issues PFS 設計議題
blocks.en: 12.2 PFS Design Issues

blocks.zh: PFS 三大 CCI 關鍵介面
blocks.en: The Three Critical CCI Interfaces of a PFS

blocks.zh: PFS 的密封完整性由三個介面共同維持，每個介面都有其特定的 CCI 功能和潛在失效模式：
blocks.en: The sealing integrity of a PFS is maintained jointly by three interfaces, each with its own CCI function and potential failure modes:

blocks.zh: 活塞/筒身介面 (Plunger Stopper/Barrel)：防止藥品洩漏和溶媒損失，主要密封機制為橡皮活塞的環形接觸壓力
blocks.en: Plunger stopper/barrel interface: prevents drug leakage and loss of solvent; the main sealing mechanism is the circumferential contact pressure of the rubber plunger stopper

blocks.zh: 筒身/針頭保護套介面 (Barrel/Needle-Shield)：防止針頭和針端受到微生物污染，密封效果受針頭保護套材質和設計影響
blocks.en: Barrel/needle-shield interface: prevents microbial contamination of the needle and needle tip; sealing performance is influenced by the material and design of the needle shield

blocks.zh: 針頭/針頭保護套介面 (Needle/Needle-Shield)：防止藥品接觸外部環境，維持無菌屏障
blocks.en: Needle/needle-shield interface: prevents the drug from contacting the external environment and maintains the sterile barrier

blocks.zh: 把 PFS 想像成一個三重密封的真空保溫杯：底部是杯蓋密封圈（活塞/筒身介面）、頂部是瓶口橡皮塞（筒身/針頭保護套介面）、飲管孔是第三道密封（針頭/針頭保護套介面）。三道密封缺一不可——任何一個失效，都可能導致污染進入或藥品洩出。
blocks.en: Think of a PFS as a vacuum flask with a triple seal: the gasket under the lid (plunger stopper/barrel interface), the rubber stopper at the mouth (barrel/needle-shield interface), and the drinking-straw hole as the third seal (needle/needle-shield interface). None of the three seals can be missing: if any one fails, contamination can get in or the drug can leak out.

blocks.zh: 活塞設計與 CCI 的關聯
blocks.en: Plunger Design and CCI

blocks.zh: Leading sealing surface（前緣密封面）：直接接觸藥品，是防止藥品洩漏的第一道防線。其幾何形狀和硬度直接影響 CCI 性能。
blocks.en: Leading sealing surface: contacts the drug product directly and is the first line of defense against drug leakage. Its geometry and hardness directly affect CCI performance.

blocks.zh: Secondary sealing ribs（二次密封肋條）：提供額外的密封冗餘和行進穩定性，設計上要在保證密封的同時不過度增加滑動阻力（break-loose force / extrusion force）。
blocks.en: Secondary sealing ribs: provide additional sealing redundancy and travel stability; they must be designed to ensure sealing without unduly increasing sliding resistance (break-loose force / extrusion force).

blocks.zh: 矽油潤滑（Silicone Lubricating Fluid）：減少摩擦，但用量過多可能影響密封性能——這是矽油化（Siliconization，Section 10）與 CCI 之間的關鍵交叉點。
blocks.en: Silicone lubricating fluid: reduces friction, but excessive amounts may affect sealing performance. This is the key intersection between siliconization (Section 10) and CCI.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：針頭保護套的環境敏感性
blocks.en: Key Point: Environmental Sensitivity of the Needle Shield

blocks.zh: 不同設計的針頭保護套（如天然橡膠 vs 熱塑性彈性體 TPE）在面對滅菌循環（EO 滅菌、輻射）或 CCI 測試循環（真空條件）時，其變形行為不同。這意味著在評估 CCI 時，必須使用與實際生產相同的已滅菌元件，並考慮不同供應商/批次的差異。
blocks.en: Needle shields of different designs (for example natural rubber vs thermoplastic elastomer, TPE) deform differently when exposed to sterilization cycles (EO sterilization, irradiation) or to CCI test cycles (vacuum conditions). This means that CCI evaluation must use sterilized components identical to those used in actual production, and must take into account differences between suppliers and lots.

blocks.zh: 活塞橡皮的 leading sealing surface 幾何設計如何影響 CCI 性能？如果接觸壓力不足，會發生什麼？
blocks.en: How does the geometric design of the leading sealing surface of the plunger stopper affect CCI performance? What happens if the contact pressure is insufficient?

blocks.zh: 為什麼筒身/針頭保護套介面的 CCI 評估需要特別考慮滅菌循環的影響？以 EO 滅菌為例說明。
blocks.en: Why does the CCI evaluation of the barrel/needle-shield interface need to give special consideration to the effect of the sterilization cycle? Use EO sterilization as an example.

blocks.zh: 在 CCI 測試設計中，如何確保三個介面都得到充分評估？是否可以用單一測試方法涵蓋所有介面？
blocks.en: In CCI test design, how can you ensure that all three interfaces are adequately evaluated? Can a single test method cover all interfaces?

blocks.zh: 12.3 Supplier and Pharmaceutical Processes 供應商與藥廠製程
blocks.en: 12.3 Supplier and Pharmaceutical Processes

blocks.zh: CCI 保證的供應鏈維度
blocks.en: The Supply Chain Dimension of CCI Assurance

blocks.zh: CCI 保證不始於灌裝，而始於元件供應商的設計開發階段。整個供應鏈的 CCI 責任分工：
blocks.en: CCI assurance does not begin at filling but at the design and development stage at the component supplier. The division of CCI responsibilities across the supply chain:

blocks.zh: 供應商：設計驗證、製程驗證、品質規格制定、統計製程管控
blocks.en: Supplier: design verification, process validation, quality specification setting, statistical process control

blocks.zh: 藥廠（CDMO）：來料管控策略、批次放行判斷、組裝製程驗證
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical manufacturer (CDMO): incoming material control strategy, lot release decisions, assembly process validation

blocks.zh: 雙方共同：圖面與規格的一致性協議 (Design Outputs Agreement)
blocks.en: Both parties jointly: an agreement on the consistency of drawings and specifications (Design Outputs Agreement)

blocks.zh: CCI 相關的關鍵元件屬性
blocks.en: Key Component Attributes Related to CCI

blocks.zh: 與 CCI 直接相關的元件關鍵屬性包括：
blocks.en: The critical component attributes directly related to CCI include:

blocks.zh: 幾何尺寸：筒身內徑、活塞外徑的公差堆疊直接決定密封接觸壓力
blocks.en: Geometric dimensions: the tolerance stack-up of barrel inner diameter and plunger stopper outer diameter directly determines the sealing contact pressure

blocks.zh: 清潔度：可見異物可能阻礙密封介面的接觸
blocks.en: Cleanliness: visible foreign matter may obstruct contact at the sealing interface

blocks.zh: 元件完整性：彈性體撕裂、玻璃裂紋、針頭穿破針頭保護套等缺陷直接破壞 CCI
blocks.en: Component integrity: defects such as elastomer tears, glass cracks and needle penetration through the needle shield directly compromise CCI

blocks.zh: 針頭穿刺深度 (Needle Puncture)：供應商的關鍵製程內管控項目
blocks.en: Needle puncture depth: a critical in-process control item at the supplier

blocks.zh: 來料管控策略就像餐廳對食材的驗收制度。對於高風險食材（如生魚片），每批都要有溫度記錄和細菌檢測報告；對於低風險食材（如鹽），只需供應商品質保證書即可。PFS 來料管控也是這個邏輯：CCI 相關的關鍵屬性（Critical）需要批批驗收，一般外觀屬性（Minor）可以用供應商 COA 代替。
blocks.en: An incoming material control strategy is like a restaurant's goods-receiving system. For high-risk ingredients (such as raw fish), every delivery needs a temperature record and a bacterial test report; for low-risk ingredients (such as salt), a supplier quality certificate is enough. PFS incoming material control follows the same logic: CCI-related critical attributes (Critical) need to be checked lot by lot, while general appearance attributes (Minor) can be covered by the supplier COA.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：AQL 與製程能力的應用
blocks.en: Key Point: Application of AQL and Process Capability

blocks.zh: AQL (Acceptable Quality Level)：基於抽樣統計的驗收準則，適用於批次評估，但無法保證每個單元都合規。
blocks.en: AQL (Acceptable Quality Level): an acceptance criterion based on sampling statistics. It is suitable for lot evaluation but cannot guarantee that every unit complies.

blocks.zh: 製程能力 (Process Capability, Cp/Cpk)：更能反映製程的長期穩定性，應作為評估供應商持續供貨能力的重要工具。
blocks.en: Process capability (Cp/Cpk): better reflects the long-term stability of a process and should be used as an important tool to evaluate a supplier's ability to supply consistently.

blocks.zh: 對於 CCI 關鍵屬性，單靠 AQL 抽樣是不夠的——應配合供應商的 SPC 數據和製程能力分析，確保元件尺寸始終在可接受範圍內。
blocks.en: For CCI-critical attributes, AQL sampling alone is not enough. It should be combined with the supplier's SPC data and process capability analysis to ensure that component dimensions always remain within the acceptable range.

blocks.zh: 在你的 CDMO 建立 PFS 元件來料管控策略時，如何判斷哪些屬性應歸為「Critical」？請列出至少三個 CCI 相關關鍵屬性。
blocks.en: When establishing an incoming material control strategy for PFS components at your CDMO, how do you decide which attributes should be classified as "Critical"? List at least three CCI-related critical attributes.

blocks.zh: 如果供應商提供的 COA 顯示某批次彈性體活塞的尺寸偏向規格下限，你會如何處理？需要進行額外的來料測試嗎？
blocks.en: If the supplier's COA shows that the dimensions of a lot of elastomer plunger stoppers are skewed toward the lower specification limit, how would you handle it? Is additional incoming testing needed?

blocks.zh: 設計輸出協議 (Design Outputs Agreement) 對 CDMO 和元件供應商之間的品質責任分工有什麼實質意義？
blocks.en: What practical significance does the Design Outputs Agreement have for the division of quality responsibilities between the CDMO and the component supplier?

blocks.zh: 12.3.3 Semifinished Syringes 半成品注射器
blocks.en: 12.3.3 Semifinished Syringes

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Semifinished Syringe（半成品注射器）：指已充填藥品並密封，但尚未安裝推桿（plunger rod）的注射器。這是藥品的一次包裝 (primary packaging) 形式，也是 CCI 評估的主要對象。
blocks.en: Semifinished syringe: a syringe that has been filled with drug product and sealed but has not yet been fitted with a plunger rod. It is the primary packaging form of the drug product and the main object of CCI evaluation.

blocks.zh: CCI 與產品生命週期的關聯：CCI 評估貫穿產品全生命週期：
blocks.en: CCI and the product lifecycle: CCI evaluation runs through the entire product lifecycle:

blocks.zh: 開發階段：以最差條件 (worst-case) 挑戰系統極限
blocks.en: Development stage: challenge the limits of the system under worst-case conditions

blocks.zh: 量產階段：以製程中檢查或放行檢測持續監控
blocks.en: Commercial production stage: monitor continuously through in-process checks or release testing

blocks.zh: 穩定性階段：評估包裝材料老化對 CCI 的影響
blocks.en: Stability stage: evaluate the effect of aging of packaging materials on CCI

blocks.zh: 想像你買了一棟新房子（半成品注射器）。在交屋前（開發階段），你會請工程師用最嚴格的標準測試門窗的氣密性；住進去後（量產階段），你定期檢查門窗是否仍然密合；住了十年後（穩定性階段），你還要評估窗框膠條老化是否導致漏風。CCI 的全生命週期評估就是這個道理——房子（注射器）在每個階段都可能面臨不同的洩漏風險。
blocks.en: Imagine you have bought a new house (the semifinished syringe). Before handover (development stage), you ask an engineer to test the airtightness of the doors and windows to the strictest standard. After moving in (commercial production stage), you check regularly that the doors and windows still close tightly. Ten years later (stability stage), you also need to assess whether aging of the window-frame seals is causing drafts. Lifecycle CCI evaluation follows the same logic: the house (syringe) may face different leakage risks at each stage.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: FDA 的重要建議：CCI 評估可以取代穩定性研究中的無菌試驗 (sterility testing)。這是因為經過驗證的 CCI 測試方法（特別是確定性方法）比傳統的無菌試驗更靈敏、更可靠。
blocks.en: An important FDA recommendation: CCI evaluation can replace sterility testing in stability studies. This is because a validated CCI test method (especially a deterministic one) is more sensitive and more reliable than conventional sterility testing.

blocks.zh: Worst-case 挑戰的具體做法：包括使用超過正常滅菌參數的元件（如更高劑量的輻射滅菌），以及使用不同批次、不同使用年限的元件，確保涵蓋批次間變異和材料老化的影響。
blocks.en: Specifics of worst-case challenges: these include using components that exceed the normal sterilization parameters (for example a higher dose of radiation sterilization) and using components from different lots and of different ages, to ensure that lot-to-lot variability and the effects of material aging are covered.

blocks.zh: 配送風險不可忽視
blocks.en: Distribution Risk Must Not Be Ignored

blocks.zh: 溫度、振動、壓力變化以及注射器內氣泡大小都可能導致活塞過度移動 (excessive plunger movement)，進而破壞無菌性。對半成品注射器（無推桿固定活塞）而言，活塞移動風險更高，必須特別評估。
blocks.en: Temperature, vibration, pressure changes and the size of the air bubble in the syringe can all cause excessive plunger movement, which in turn compromises sterility. For semifinished syringes (with no plunger rod to hold the stopper in place), the risk of plunger movement is higher and must be specifically evaluated.

blocks.zh: 為什麼開發階段要使用超出正常參數的元件來進行 CCI 測試？這與 worst-case 驗證策略有何關聯？
blocks.en: Why should components outside the normal parameters be used for CCI testing in the development stage? How does this relate to a worst-case validation strategy?

blocks.zh: FDA 建議在穩定性研究中以 CCI 測試取代無菌試驗，請說明其科學依據和實務優勢。
blocks.en: FDA recommends replacing sterility testing with CCI testing in stability studies. Explain the scientific basis and practical advantages.

blocks.zh: 半成品注射器在運輸過程中，為什麼比已組裝的 PFS 更容易出現活塞移動問題？
blocks.en: Why are semifinished syringes more prone to plunger movement during transport than assembled PFSs?

blocks.zh: 12.3.4 Syringe Assembly and Secondary Packaging 注射器組裝與二次包裝
blocks.en: 12.3.4 Syringe Assembly and Secondary Packaging

blocks.zh: 組裝 PFS 的 CCI 前提：組裝完成的預充填注射器（含 finger-flange 指法蘭和 plunger rod 推桿）其 CCI 保障的基礎，完全建立在進入組裝製程前的半成品注射器的無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance) 和 CCI 之上。換句話說，如果半成品注射器本身的 CCI 已經有問題，後續的組裝過程無法彌補。
blocks.en: Prerequisite for CCI of an assembled PFS: the CCI assurance of an assembled prefilled syringe (with finger flange and plunger rod) rests entirely on the sterility assurance and CCI of the semifinished syringe before it enters the assembly process. In other words, if the CCI of the semifinished syringe is already compromised, the subsequent assembly process cannot make up for it.

blocks.zh: 關鍵失效模式：
blocks.en: Critical failure modes:

blocks.zh: Plunger stopper（活塞膠塞）移動
blocks.en: Plunger stopper movement

blocks.zh: Needle-shield（針頭保護套）移動
blocks.en: Needle-shield movement

blocks.zh: 半成品注射器在組裝過程中受到物理損傷
blocks.en: Physical damage to the semifinished syringe during assembly

blocks.zh: 組裝過程就像在已經密封好的食品罐頭上貼標籤和裝箱。如果貼標機的壓力太大，可能會壓凹罐頭導致密封失效。同理，注射器組裝過程中安裝推桿或指法蘭時施加的力道，必須經過風險評估和驗證，確保不會造成活塞移動或針頭保護套鬆脫。
blocks.en: The assembly process is like labeling and boxing cans of food that are already sealed. If the labeling machine applies too much pressure, it may dent the can and break the seal. Likewise, the force applied when installing the plunger rod or finger flange during syringe assembly must be risk assessed and validated to ensure that it does not cause plunger movement or loosening of the needle shield.

blocks.zh: 組裝與二次包裝製程必須經過驗證 (validation)，證明最終產品符合既定標準且適合其預期用途。這裡的驗證應涵蓋正常操作條件和最差操作條件，並採用 FMEA 等工具識別所有可能的失效模式。
blocks.en: The assembly and secondary packaging processes must be validated to demonstrate that the final product meets the established standards and is suitable for its intended use. Validation here should cover both normal and worst-case operating conditions, and use tools such as FMEA to identify all possible failure modes.

blocks.zh: 在組裝製程的風險評估中，你會如何評估推桿安裝力道對 CCI 的影響？需要設計哪些試驗？
blocks.en: In the risk assessment of the assembly process, how would you evaluate the effect of plunger rod installation force on CCI? What studies would you design?

blocks.zh: 為什麼說組裝後 PFS 的 CCI 取決於進入組裝前半成品注射器的品質？這對來料管控有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Why is the CCI of an assembled PFS said to depend on the quality of the semifinished syringe before assembly? What does this imply for incoming material control?

blocks.zh: 12.3.5 Shipping and Distribution of Semifinished Syringes and PFSs 半成品注射器與 PFS 的運輸與配送
blocks.en: 12.3.5 Shipping and Distribution of Semifinished Syringes and PFSs

blocks.zh: Shipping Studies（運輸研究）：用於評估產品在運輸過程中暴露於各種應力條件後，是否仍能維持 CCI。典型的運輸應力包括：
blocks.en: Shipping studies: used to evaluate whether the product still maintains CCI after exposure to various stress conditions during transport. Typical transport stresses include:

blocks.zh: 機械力 (Mechanical forces)：搬運碰撞、堆疊壓力
blocks.en: Mechanical forces: handling impacts, stacking pressure

blocks.zh: 壓力變化 (Pressure changes)：航空運輸時的氣壓變化尤為顯著
blocks.en: Pressure changes: especially pronounced in air transport

blocks.zh: 振動 (Vibrations)：卡車運輸中的持續振動
blocks.en: Vibrations: continuous vibration during truck transport

blocks.zh: 就像精密的電子產品在出貨前會做「跌落測試」和「振動測試」一樣，預充填注射器也必須經過模擬運輸條件的測試。想像一支注射器從台灣工廠到歐洲患者手中，可能經歷卡車顛簸、飛機氣壓變化、倉庫堆疊——每一步都可能是 CCI 的挑戰。
blocks.en: Just as precision electronic products undergo "drop tests" and "vibration tests" before shipping, prefilled syringes must also be tested under simulated transport conditions. Imagine a syringe traveling from a factory in Taiwan to a patient in Europe: it may experience truck bumps, aircraft pressure changes and warehouse stacking, and each step can challenge CCI.

blocks.zh: 運輸研究應涵蓋代表性條件和/或最差條件。所謂最差條件，例如模擬跨洲航空運輸（極端氣壓和溫度變化）、冬季/夏季極端溫度、多次轉運的累積振動等。這些研究應在產品開發的適當階段進行，並在變更運輸路線或包裝方式時重新評估。
blocks.en: Shipping studies should cover representative conditions and/or worst-case conditions. Worst-case conditions include, for example, simulated intercontinental air transport (extreme pressure and temperature changes), extreme winter/summer temperatures, and cumulative vibration over multiple transshipments. These studies should be performed at an appropriate stage of product development and re-evaluated when the shipping route or packaging method changes.

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品需要從台灣經航空運輸至歐洲，在設計運輸研究時應考慮哪些最差條件？
blocks.en: If your product needs to be shipped by air from Taiwan to Europe, what worst-case conditions should be considered when designing the shipping study?

blocks.zh: 運輸過程中的壓力變化如何可能影響注射器內部的氣泡大小和活塞位置？
blocks.en: How might pressure changes during transport affect the size of the air bubble inside the syringe and the position of the plunger stopper?

blocks.zh: 12.4 CCI Test Method Toolbox: Method Selection, Development, and Validation CCI 測試方法工具箱：方法選擇、開發與驗證
blocks.en: 12.4 CCI Test Method Toolbox: Method Selection, Development, and Validation

blocks.zh: 六大 CCI 測試技術概覽
blocks.en: Overview of the Six CCI Test Technologies

blocks.zh: Microbial Ingress（微生物侵入試驗）：以微生物作為挑戰介質，機率性，破壞性
blocks.en: Microbial ingress: uses microorganisms as the challenge medium; probabilistic, destructive

blocks.zh: Dye Immersion（染料浸入試驗）：浸入染料溶液檢查滲入，機率性，破壞性
blocks.en: Dye immersion: immersion in a dye solution to check for ingress; probabilistic, destructive

blocks.zh: Pressure/Vacuum Decay（壓力/真空衰減）：施加壓差監測洩漏，確定性，非破壞性
blocks.en: Pressure/vacuum decay: applies a pressure differential and monitors for leakage; deterministic, nondestructive

blocks.zh: Mass Extraction（質量萃取）：透過質量流量偵測洩漏，確定性，非破壞性
blocks.en: Mass extraction: detects leakage through mass flow; deterministic, nondestructive

blocks.zh: High-Voltage Leak Detection, HVLD（高壓漏電偵測）：利用電流偵測缺陷，確定性，非破壞性
blocks.en: High-voltage leak detection (HVLD): detects defects using electrical current; deterministic, nondestructive

blocks.zh: Helium-Leak Detection（氦氣洩漏偵測）：最高靈敏度，確定性，非破壞性
blocks.en: Helium leak detection: highest sensitivity; deterministic, nondestructive

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 框架：確定性 vs 機率性
blocks.en: The USP <1207> Framework: Deterministic vs Probabilistic

blocks.zh: USP <1207> Package Integrity Evaluation — Sterile Products 是 CCI 測試方法選擇的核心指引，明確區分兩類方法：
blocks.en: USP <1207> Package Integrity Evaluation — Sterile Products is the core guidance for selecting CCI test methods and clearly distinguishes two classes of methods:

blocks.zh: Deterministic Methods（確定性方法）：基於物理或化學量測原理，結果具有明確的定量數值（如壓力衰減速率、氦氣質量流量），可客觀判斷通過/不通過。包括真空/壓力衰減、HVLD 和氦氣洩漏偵測。
blocks.en: Deterministic methods: based on physical or chemical measurement principles, with clear quantitative results (such as pressure decay rate or helium mass flow rate) that allow an objective pass/fail decision. They include vacuum/pressure decay, HVLD and helium leak detection.

blocks.zh: Probabilistic Methods（機率性方法）：結果取決於多個不可完全控制的變數（如微生物生長、染料滲透路徑），每次測試可能得到不同結果，靈敏度受缺陷大小、形狀和方向影響。包括染料浸入和微生物侵入。
blocks.en: Probabilistic methods: the result depends on multiple variables that cannot be fully controlled (such as microbial growth or the dye penetration path), so each test may give a different result, and sensitivity is affected by defect size, shape and orientation. They include dye immersion and microbial ingress.

blocks.zh: 法規趨勢：USP <1207> 和 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 均推薦優先選擇確定性方法。PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8.90 明確指出「無菌屏障系統的完整性測試應優先使用確定性物理化學方法」。
blocks.en: Regulatory trend: both USP <1207> and PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) recommend giving preference to deterministic methods. PIC/S Annex 1 Section 8.90 states explicitly that "integrity testing of the sterile barrier system should preferably use deterministic physical and chemical methods".

blocks.zh: 把 CCI 測試方法想像成檢查輪胎是否漏氣的方式：
blocks.en: Think of CCI test methods as ways of checking whether a tire is leaking:

blocks.zh: 氦氣偵測 = 用質譜儀精確量測氣體分子洩漏量 → 最靈敏
blocks.en: Helium detection = measuring the exact amount of gas leaking with a mass spectrometer → most sensitive

blocks.zh: 真空/壓力衰減 = 用精密氣壓表量測壓力變化 → 定量、可重複
blocks.en: Vacuum/pressure decay = measuring pressure change with a precision pressure gauge → quantitative, repeatable

blocks.zh: HVLD = 用電子儀器掃描輪胎表面 → 快速、非破壞性
blocks.en: HVLD = scanning the tire surface with an electronic instrument → fast, nondestructive

blocks.zh: 染料浸入 = 把輪胎泡在肥皂水裡看氣泡 → 簡單但靈敏度低
blocks.en: Dye immersion = soaking the tire in soapy water and watching for bubbles → simple but low sensitivity

blocks.zh: 微生物侵入 = 等著看輪胎裡是否長黴 → 最不靈敏、最後手段
blocks.en: Microbial ingress = waiting to see whether mold grows inside the tire → least sensitive, last resort

blocks.zh: 重點提示：方法選擇的產品相容性考量
blocks.en: Key Point: Product Compatibility in Method Selection

blocks.zh: 低電導率的填充液 → 不適用 HVLD
blocks.en: Low-conductivity fill solution → HVLD not suitable

blocks.zh: 高濃度蛋白質藥品 → 可能堵塞缺陷通道，使真空衰減法不可靠
blocks.en: High-concentration protein drug product → may block the defect channel, making vacuum decay unreliable

blocks.zh: 需要進行 100% 線上檢測 → 需考慮檢測速度和通量（非破壞性方法優先）
blocks.en: 100% inline testing required → consider test speed and throughput (nondestructive methods preferred)

blocks.zh: 大多數注射裝置 → HVLD 不適用（電場難以穿透針頭保護套覆蓋區域）
blocks.en: Most injection devices → HVLD not suitable (the electric field has difficulty penetrating the area covered by the needle shield)

blocks.zh: 需要定量洩漏數據 → 真空/壓力衰減或氦氣偵測
blocks.en: Quantitative leak data required → vacuum/pressure decay or helium detection

blocks.zh: 正控制樣品 (Positive Controls)：使用已知缺陷大小的樣品（透過微量移液管、金屬線、毛細管柱、雷射鑽孔或 MEMS 微機電系統製備）來驗證方法的靈敏度和可靠性。
blocks.en: Positive controls: samples with known defect sizes (prepared by micropipette, metal wire, capillary column, laser drilling or MEMS) are used to verify the sensitivity and reliability of the method.

blocks.zh: 驗證的階段適配性
blocks.en: Phase-Appropriate Validation

blocks.zh: CCI 測試方法驗證應隨產品開發階段逐步深化：
blocks.en: Validation of CCI test methods should deepen progressively with the stage of product development:

blocks.zh: 早期開發：方法適用性評估、初步參數優化
blocks.en: Early development: method suitability assessment, preliminary parameter optimization

blocks.zh: 工程研究/穩定性研究：方法應用於支持決策
blocks.en: Engineering studies/stability studies: the method is applied to support decisions

blocks.zh: 上市申請前：完整的 ICH 方法驗證，包括準確度、精密度、穩健性
blocks.en: Before marketing application: full ICH method validation, including accuracy, precision and robustness

blocks.zh: 商業化 QC：方法穩健性研究確保長期例行使用可靠
blocks.en: Commercial QC: method robustness studies to ensure reliability in long-term routine use

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設你在 CDMO 負責一款高濃度單株抗體預充填注射器的 CCI 測試方法開發。由於蛋白質濃度高（>100 mg/mL），真空衰減法可能因蛋白質堵塞缺陷而產生假陰性。此時你應優先評估 HVLD（需確認充填液電導率足夠）或氦氣洩漏偵測（需確認頂空含氦氣）。這就是「方法選擇必須適合預期用途」的典型案例。
blocks.en: Suppose you are responsible for developing a CCI test method for a high-concentration monoclonal antibody prefilled syringe at a CDMO. Because of the high protein concentration (>100 mg/mL), vacuum decay may give false negatives as protein blocks the defect. In this case you should first evaluate HVLD (the conductivity of the fill solution must be confirmed to be sufficient) or helium leak detection (the headspace must be confirmed to contain helium). This is a typical case of "the method selected must be suitable for its intended use".

blocks.zh: 請解釋為什麼確定性方法 (deterministic methods) 在法規上越來越受到青睞？與機率性方法相比，其核心優勢是什麼？
blocks.en: Explain why deterministic methods are increasingly favored by regulators. What is their core advantage compared with probabilistic methods?

blocks.zh: 在優化 CCI 測試方法時，為什麼需要測試涵蓋不同批次、不同濃度、不同產線的完好樣品？
blocks.en: When optimizing a CCI test method, why is it necessary to test intact samples from different lots, different concentrations and different production lines?

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品是水溶液（電導率高），但需要 100% 線上檢測，你會優先考慮哪種 CCI 測試方法？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your product is an aqueous solution (high conductivity) but requires 100% inline testing, which CCI test method would you consider first, and why?

blocks.zh: 選擇確定性方法（PIC/S Annex 1 §8.90 要求）：
blocks.en: Choose a deterministic method (required by PIC/S Annex 1 §8.90):

blocks.zh: 小分子注射液（高電導率）→ HVLD 優先，速度快、100% 線上可行
blocks.en: Small-molecule injectables (high conductivity) → HVLD first; fast, and 100% inline testing is feasible

blocks.zh: 高濃度蛋白質製劑 → 真空衰減需充分驗證（蛋白質堵塞風險）；氦氣偵測靈敏度最高
blocks.en: High-concentration protein formulations → vacuum decay needs thorough validation (risk of protein blocking); helium detection has the highest sensitivity

blocks.zh: 注射裝置（針頭保護套）→ 真空/壓力衰減（HVLD 覆蓋盲區）
blocks.en: Injection devices (needle shield) → vacuum/pressure decay (HVLD has a coverage blind spot)

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 合規要點：確定性方法具備客觀定量結果，符合分析方法驗證（準確度、精密度、線性、LOD/LOQ）的 ICH Q2(R1) 要求，便於建立合規的驗證包。機率性方法難以完整驗證，應視為補充或最後手段。
blocks.en: Key points for USP <1207> compliance: deterministic methods give objective, quantitative results and meet the ICH Q2(R1) requirements for analytical method validation (accuracy, precision, linearity, LOD/LOQ), which makes it easier to build a compliant validation package. Probabilistic methods are difficult to validate fully and should be regarded as supplementary or a last resort.

blocks.zh: 氦氣偵測靈敏度最高的物理原因
blocks.en: The Physical Reason Helium Detection Is Most Sensitive

blocks.zh: 氦原子（He）是惰性氣體中分子量最小的元素（原子量 4），分子動力直徑極小（約 0.26 nm），遠小於空氣主要成分氮（0.364 nm）和氧（0.346 nm）。這使氦原子能穿透更小的缺陷，搭配質譜儀（mass spectrometer）的高靈敏度偵測，可達 0.1–2 µm 的偵測極限，是所有 CCI 方法中最高的。
blocks.en: The helium atom (He) has the smallest atomic mass of the noble gases (atomic mass 4) and a very small kinetic diameter (about 0.26 nm), much smaller than nitrogen (0.364 nm) and oxygen (0.346 nm), the main components of air. This allows helium atoms to pass through smaller defects. Combined with the high sensitivity of mass spectrometer detection, a detection limit of 0.1–2 µm can be reached, the highest of all CCI methods.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 12.0 CCI 在無菌保證計畫中是多層次管控的一環，最終目標是證明 PFS 能維持其微生物屏障的完整性。應採用風險基礎、階段適配的方法，貫穿設計確認到商業化穩定性研究。
blocks.en: 12.0 CCI in the sterility assurance program is one part of a multi-layered control approach, and its ultimate goal is to demonstrate that the PFS maintains the integrity of its microbial barrier. A risk-based, phase-appropriate approach should be used, running from design qualification through to commercial stability studies.

blocks.zh: 12.1 法規依據：整體性無菌保證三層架構（製程驗證 + CCI 保證 + 放行無菌試驗）。C/C 系統適用性的四個面向：保護性、安全性、相容性、性能。PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 明確要求優先使用確定性 CCI 測試方法。
blocks.en: 12.1 Regulatory basis: the three-layer structure of holistic sterility assurance (process validation + CCI assurance + release sterility testing). The four aspects of C/C system suitability: protection, safety, compatibility and performance. PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) explicitly requires preference for deterministic CCI test methods.

blocks.zh: 12.2 PFS 設計議題：三大密封介面（活塞/筒身、筒身/針頭保護套、針頭/針頭保護套）各有其 CCI 功能。元件設計（leading sealing surface、sealing ribs）和矽油潤滑直接影響密封性能。
blocks.en: 12.2 PFS design issues: the three sealing interfaces (plunger stopper/barrel, barrel/needle shield, needle/needle shield) each have their own CCI function. Component design (leading sealing surface, sealing ribs) and silicone lubrication directly affect sealing performance.

blocks.zh: 12.3 供應商與藥廠製程：CCI 保證始於供應商設計開發階段，涵蓋來料管控（AQL/製程能力）、半成品注射器全生命週期評估、組裝製程驗證和運輸研究。
blocks.en: 12.3 Supplier and pharmaceutical processes: CCI assurance starts at the supplier's design and development stage and covers incoming material control (AQL/process capability), lifecycle evaluation of semifinished syringes, assembly process validation and shipping studies.

blocks.zh: 12.4 CCI 測試方法工具箱：依據 USP <1207> 框架，確定性方法（真空衰減、HVLD、氦氣偵測）優於機率性方法（染料浸入、微生物侵入）。方法選擇需考慮充填液特性（電導率、蛋白質含量）、是否需要 100% 線上檢測及定量資訊。氦氣偵測靈敏度最高（0.1–2 µm）但需含氦頂空；HVLD 高通量但需導電填充液；真空衰減適用範圍最廣，是大多數 PFS 的首選確定性方法。
blocks.en: 12.4 CCI test method toolbox: under the USP <1207> framework, deterministic methods (vacuum decay, HVLD, helium detection) are preferred over probabilistic methods (dye immersion, microbial ingress). Method selection must consider the properties of the fill solution (conductivity, protein content), whether 100% inline testing is needed, and the need for quantitative information. Helium detection has the highest sensitivity (0.1–2 µm) but requires a helium-containing headspace; HVLD offers high throughput but requires a conductive fill; vacuum decay has the widest applicability and is the first-choice deterministic method for most PFSs.
